versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of web-content-fetcher

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates to features, documentation, or scripts.
- Version bump only; functionality remains unchanged.

- Initial release of the web-content-fetcher tool.
- Provides alternative services to fetch webpage content as Markdown when standard methods fail.
- Supports r.jina.ai (primary, stable), markdown.new (for Cloudflare-protected sites), and defuddle.md (backup).
- Includes example usage and a shell script (fetch.sh) for command-line calls.
- Supports trigger phrases in both Chinese and English.
